svg.title: MSCA-Lite scale alignment and elementwise weighting
svg.desc: The three vertical columns align the identity, 2 by 2 pooled and 4 by 4 pooled views to 40 by 40. Their pointwise mean is the input to the energy gate. The lower line carries the original F into the product. The tiles illustrate a single spatial slice computed for this diagram from a VisDrone image crop, with no trained activations depicted.
svg.metadata: Revision 44, Figure 4. Scientific source: MSCA_Lite.forward, Figure 4 label sheet and equations (1)–(2) of revision 44. Design reference: LoftUp, ICCV 2025, Fig. 3, for visible spatial resolutions. All example maps are computed on a 40 by 40 luminance slice of VisDrone 0000001_02999_d_0000005.jpg. The same color mapping is used for every example map.
